Organizations and people named here, and anyone else, can submit corrections or evidence until then; what arrives becomes the launch round of the paper. No tag is citable until the gates pass. Assurance regime; jurisdiction US

Dietary supplements (US)

A regime that moved backward: pre-market review removed by statute, private verification never made mandatory, no oversight of the verifiers. Shows that a trigger does not guarantee reform.

Voluntary marks; no oversight of verifiers.

Payer, access, publication

Who pays. Manufacturer pays private verifiers; verification is voluntary.
Access. Voluntary submission of samples and facility audits.
Publication. Verification marks public; adverse event reports to FDA.
